b4BaselineNote: RULED SABLE_RIVER 2026-08-17: the B4 zero-framework-diff gate (BG-COMPOSE-SIF, BRIEF-B4) measures the B4 branch's diff against THIS commit, not against edfiPluginAcceptedCommitRecorded. The two differ, and the difference is real and legitimate: the DERIVED order (D1-D4) moved lib/bridge-framework between b86f57a and 3e5357f — the SOURCE_ACQUISITION_REGISTRY, four real-client judge contract fixes, and the sssomExporter validator-conformance commit. Diffing b86f57a..<sif commit> would go red for those changes, which have nothing to do with SIF. The claim B4 has to prove is that SIF adds nothing to the framework IT IS ADDED TO, so the baseline is the framework as it stood when B4 branched. The RULINGS B3-CLEAR line naming b86f57a as B4's baseline is superseded for B4 and the supersession is recorded here rather than left as a silent reinterpretation.
b4TwinRangeNote: test-bridgeAcceptanceSif.js's BG-COMPOSE-SIF twin runs the IDENTICAL diff command over edfiPluginAcceptedCommitRecorded..b4BaselineCommit, where the DERIVED order really did move lib/bridge-framework, and asserts NON-EMPTY. A diff gate that reports EMPTY is indistinguishable from one whose path list is misspelled, whose command failed, or whose parser never sees a line — all of those report EMPTY too, greenly, forever. The twin turns the silence into a measurement. Pattern for every diff-from-tag gate (RULED SABLE_RIVER 2026-08-17).
b4BaselineMoverNote: NAMED MOVER (RULING BS-7, SABLE_RIVER 2026-08-17): the baseline moved from 3e5357f6fba41b2575e893a9465bf4d557b424e2 to 55357b5 when the supervisor rebased b4-sif-plugin onto the post-D-CLEAR HEAD. The cause is named and singular: B4 branched BEFORE 1393f82 (BR-067 purpose-satisfied + symmetric-contrast re-ask + named refusal net), the fix without which the Ed-Fi D4 real run died at subject 50 of 701, and before c64d6d3 (DR-2: the SSSOM exporter emitting subject_match_field by DISPOSITION rather than unconditionally). B4 must INHERIT both rather than freeze ahead of them, because CP3 puts a real model through exactly that re-ask path and exports through exactly that exporter. CONSEQUENCE, stated before the re-run so the check afterwards is an assertion rather than an interpretation: the frameworkFingerprint moves, and with it the decision block id, the relationship block id and the manifest id — all one named mover. THE CENSUS MUST NOT MOVE. The classifier reads inputs the judge never touches, so a judge-side fix cannot legitimately shift a single classifier count; a census that moves is a DEFECT, not a re-key. Verified safe for SIF before running: the new SSSOM disposition table gives producerKind authored subjectMatchField "required", which is what SIF needs.
